messages:
alex: Heads-up: MI300 shipments to APAC are slipping ~3 weeks — vendor confirmed. Need fallthrough plan for marketplace regional rollout. @maria @kevin
maria: Noted. what's the earliest impact on announce window? :thinking:
alex: target announce was 2025-04-10. If slips 3w, APAC region could miss initial wave. We should consider H200 regional bump or allow Gaudi in APAC as fallback.
kevin: Agree. Quick checklist:
- designate fallback SKU per region
- update marketplace meta with 'ship by' dates
- update PR embargo windows
- ops to run smoke on H200 images

kevin: I'll assign ops, @danielle can you validate drivers for H200

danielle: on it. running driver validation w/ infra team. ETA 48h.
vendor-bot: Vendor update: MI300 firmware queue cleared; earliest ship dates updated: APAC 2025-04-28 -> 2025-05-19.
alex: that's 3.1 weeks. So announce should either be global with APAC delayed, or staggered. Preference for a single global announce + region followup? Thoughts.
maria: prefer staggered: keep EMEA/NA on 4/10, APAC with 'coming soon' + dedicated PR on 5/20. less risky for customers.
kevin: Ops impact: double cutover, need canary images and rollback plan. we should codify runbook snippet:
```
Canary plan:
1) deploy H200 fallback pool in APAC
2) run 100 qps smoke for 2h
3) switch 10% traffic -> fallback
4) monitor latency/cost for 4h
5) full flip if OK
```
kevin: Also ensure billing SKU mapping in marketplace reflects fallback pricing.
danielle: driver smoke started on `staging-h200-1` at 11:20 PST, logs in #eng-infra.
alex: can we get a short customer-facing FAQ blurb about 'regional availability' for press? @maria
maria: I'll draft: one para + bulleted rollback note. will share in #marketing by EOD.
kevin: I'll update the ops runbook and ping legal re: embargo wording.
alex: thanks all. action items: @danielle driver validation, @kevin ops runbook + billing mapping, @maria customer FAQ + PR plan, i'll draft vendor comms and embargo note.
kevin: tagging follow-ups: #release-war-room dry-run 4/03 09:00 PT.
maria: ack. :thumbsup:
vendor-bot: Next vendor ETA check scheduled 2025-04-25.
alex: closing thread — we'll use this as the source of truth. small updates only here pls. :lock:
